fields.description: Name shown in lists, e.g. Bangalore 1.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Clear to stop placing new tenants here. Current tenants keep working. The default cluster cannot be disabled.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Pending: no node yet. Bootstrapping: waits for the certificate. Active: ready for tenants. Failed: the first node did not start. Provision it again.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Stalwart release the nodes run. Change it and run Upgrade Nodes.
fields.label: Stalwart Version

fields.description: Short ID under the zone, e.g. blr gives mail.blr.frappemail.com. Blank gives c1, c2 and so on. Cannot be changed.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Zone for the cluster's hostnames and records. Cannot be changed after save.
fields.label: DNS Zone

fields.description: Public address of the cluster, e.g. mail.blr.frappemail.com.
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: Sub-zone for nodes, gateways and pools, e.g. blr.frappemail.com.
fields.label: Default Domain

fields.description: JMAP URL given to tenants.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Certificate authority. Blank uses Suite Cloud Settings.
fields.label: ACME Directory URL

fields.description: Gets notices about expiring certificates. Blank uses Suite Cloud Settings.
fields.label: ACME Contact Email

fields.description: Tenants go here when no cluster lists their region. There is always one default.
fields.label: Is Default

fields.description: Region codes this cluster serves, e.g. blr.
fields.label: Regions Served

fields.description: Settings, directory and message metadata. Use PostgreSQL or MySQL. RocksDB is for a single test node.
fields.label: Data Store

fields.description: Message bodies and attachments. Blank uses the data store.
fields.label: Blob Store

fields.description: Full-text index. Blank uses the data store.
fields.label: Search Store

fields.description: Caches, rate limits and coordination. Blank uses the data store. More than one node needs Redis.
fields.label: In-Memory Store

fields.description: Set automatically. Default when a multi-node cluster has a Redis store.
fields.label: Coordinator

fields.description: Set automatically when a store is local. The cluster can have only one node.
fields.label: Single Node Only

fields.description: Generated on save.
fields.label: Admin Password

fields.description: Token Suite Cloud uses for management calls. Rotate API Key replaces it.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: User Ansible logs in as. Needs root or passwordless sudo.
fields.label: SSH User

fields.description: Nodes can override it.
fields.label: SSH Port

fields.description: Add it to the authorized keys on each node and gateway before provisioning.
fields.label: SSH Public Key

fields.description: Generated on save.
fields.label: SSH Private Key

fields.description: Identifies the cluster to Suite Cloud. Generated on save.
fields.label: Agent Key

fields.description: Generated on save. Rotate Agent Secret replaces it and reinstalls the agents.
fields.label: Agent Secret

fields.description: Serve Stalwart metrics to the agent. Off, the agent sends host metrics only.
fields.label: Enable Prometheus Metrics

fields.description: Generated on save.
fields.label: Metrics Password

fields.description: Pool for all outbound mail. Blank sends mail directly from the nodes.
fields.label: Default Egress Pool

fields.description: SMTP user the cluster uses with its egress gateways.
fields.label: Relay Username

fields.description: Generated on save.
fields.label: Relay Password

fields.description: Ceiling for every account's Daily Send Limit and every tenant's default, in recipients per UTC day. Also the server's own cap per account while the Agents are down.
fields.label: Max Daily Send Limit

fields.description: Ceiling for every account's Monthly Send Limit and every tenant's default, in recipients per UTC month.
fields.label: Max Monthly Send Limit

fields.description: Generated on save.
fields.label: Quota Hook Token

fields.description: Node that ran the first setup.
fields.label: Bootstrap Node

fields.description: Increases on each configuration push.
fields.label: Config Version

fields.description: Why the last push failed.
fields.label: Last Config Sync Error

fields.description: Settings on the cluster that differ from the plan, from the last Check Drift.
fields.label: Drift Report

fields.description: Last generated configuration, secrets hidden.
fields.label: Config Plan
